author: Stahly
description:
A lot has already been said about Warhammer Tone Pro, but I think it's time for a more nuanced review that really gets to the bottom of GW's newest paint range. A review for painters of every level, with no agenda to please anyone. I've tested every hobby paint brand in the industry over the last few years, and in this video I'll put Tone Pro's performance against the competition into proper context.

The post Warhammer Tone Pro: the review nobody else is giving you appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Warhammer Tone Pro: the review nobody else is giving you
